name: EPIC 246384695

text.card: A red giant 3,139 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.86 solar masses and 10.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,784 K at its surface.
